type: Isolated before/after performance measurement, not an SLA or full CI run

environment.order: alternating AB/BA; all initial samples retained; API benchmark prewarms backend before browser
environment.apiConnection: one new loopback TCP connection per request; HTTP status and body receipt timed, JSON validation afterward
environment.database: one isolated tmpfs PostgreSQL shared by both variants, no application Mock mutation
environment.frontend: same production dist bytes, separate identical static HTTP/API proxies; not Vite dev server
environment.prometheus: actual existing local Prometheus for both variants; metric values naturally vary with scrape time
environment.apiOrder: four blocks of 25 requests, AB/BA alternating; 20 warmups per endpoint and variant retained separately

browser.measurement: navigation to root + Pod rows + 100000 counts + two RAFs; history/operations click dispatched in page to complete content + two RAFs
browser.operationsReady: 10 cards and actual Prometheus up=1; alert section completion not part of timing
browser.backendReadiness: servers already running; database and API prepared by the recorded API measurements; server start and first-query compilation excluded from browser target

attempts.name: first-incomplete
attempts.browser: aborted after incorrect generic button selector clicked tree reveal instead of history; not a product regression; no valid final browser report

attempts.name: setup-retry
attempts.result: port preflight hit TIME_WAIT after shutdown; no application or measurement started; reuse-address applied to diagnostic port probe only

limitations: No real Keycloak login performance rerun
No FPS or native Chrome task-manager memory measurement
No maximum throughput, remote-network or long-duration load/SLA validation
Small before/after differences include JIT, GC, scheduling and actual Prometheus variation; no statistically proven speedup claim
